editorial_approval.context_review: The complete ayah is used. The preceding passage establishes covenant and obedience; the following passage connects right action with accountability. The framing demands justice during disagreement and does not ask viewers to suppress legitimate disagreement.

source.exact_translation: You who believe, be steadfast before God as witnesses in fairness. Do not let the hatred of a people drive you away from justice. Be just—that is closer to guarding yourselves. Fear God—God is well aware of what you do.
